condition: Series.round() on an object-dtype Series (e.g. floats mixed with pd.NA) silently returns unrounded values in 2.2.x and raises TypeError in 2.3.0.
workaround: Convert to a numeric nullable dtype before rounding, e.g. ser.astype('float[pyarrow]').round(1) (or 'Float64'), or use np.nan instead of pd.NA so the dtype is float64.
